observedBehavior: Document bytes are content-addressed and every immutable version is retained during CAS sweep.
Text preview is escaped and binary media is download-only; malformed UTF-8, paths, base64 and active media are refused.
Revision creates new version IDs and preserves old digests; only current title/content is indexed.
Associations require targets in the same workspace; search and mutation require current membership and scopes.
Revocation removes current list/search visibility without deleting immutable history.
Upload and indexing never create shared-memory publications.
Resources UI supports upload, revision, association, search, preview, history and revocation.
